name: Closer Agent — Voice + Booking + No-Show Recovery

steps.label: Hot Handoff — Book Instantly
steps.message:
{{contact.first_name}} — [CLOSER NAME] here from {{location.name}}. You just got flagged as priority. I have [X] spots open this week.

Pick your time in the next 60 seconds:
→ [CALENDAR LINK]

This call closes your questions and shows you the exact system live. 10 minutes max.

steps.label: Booking Confirmation + Pre-Frame
steps.subject: You're on the calendar — here's what to expect
steps.body:
{{contact.first_name}},

You're locked in for [APPOINTMENT DATE/TIME].

Before we talk, do one thing: write down your #1 problem with [AREA]. We're going to solve it on the call or tell you exactly why we can't.

No pitch. No pressure. Binary outcome — either this works for you or it doesn't.

See you [DATE].

[CLOSER NAME]
{{location.name}}

Add to calendar: [CALENDAR LINK]
Reschedule: [RESCHEDULE LINK]

steps.label: 24hr Reminder
steps.message: Reminder {{contact.first_name}}: We're on tomorrow at [TIME]. I'll have the full system demo ready for you. Reply CONFIRM or RESCHEDULE.

steps.label: 1hr Pre-Call Spike
steps.message:
1 hour out {{contact.first_name}}. Zoom link: [ZOOM LINK]

One last thing — think about: what would [RESULT] mean for your business in 90 days? Come ready with that number. 🎯

steps.label: No-Show Recovery — Instant
steps.message: {{contact.first_name}} — missed you just now. No worries, things happen. I have one more opening [DAY] at [TIME]. Want it? Reply YES and I'll hold it for you.

steps.label: No-Show Recovery — Value Drop
steps.subject: Recorded a quick demo for you instead
steps.body:
{{contact.first_name}},

Missed you on the call — so I recorded a 3-minute demo of the exact system we would have walked through.

→ [LOOM/VIDEO LINK]

Watch it when you have 3 minutes, then reply with your biggest question. I'll answer it same day.

If after watching you want to get on a real call — here's the link:
→ [CALENDAR LINK]

[CLOSER NAME]

steps.label: No-Show Final Binary
steps.message: {{contact.first_name}} — last attempt. YES = I send you the calendar link right now and we lock it in. NO = I close your file with respect. Which is it?
